evidence: In the present study, the cryo-electron microscopy structure of the ribosome from the microsporidium Vairimorpha necatrix is presented, which illustrates how genome compaction has resulted in the smallest known eukaryotic cytoplasmic ribosome.
Ribosomes were liberated by bead beating 100 mg of spores for 30 s in a 2-ml conical microfuge tube with 0.5 g of 0.5 mm zirconium beads in buffer A
The purified ribosome sample was dried and resuspended in 8M urea/10mM dithiothreitol/0.1 M ammonium bicarbonate.
